Install Agent Runner

The runner installer prepares isolated agent workflows with deterministic cache directories and repeatable startup checks.

Python setup

Install the package in a virtual environment before connecting it to MCP.

python -m pip install agent-runner
agent-runner doctor

Successful checks confirm the command path, local scrape support, and remote API configuration.
